title: Administration - Lady Irwin College, Delhi
summary: Administration - Lady Irwin College, Delhi: The page provides basic administrative information for Lady Irwin College in Delhi, including contact details, visiting hours, and accreditation status. It lists the college’s address, phone number (014836), and indicates that the institution is part of the University of Delhi. The college holds an A+ NAAC accreditation and ranks 31 in the NIRF rankings. Quick links are available for students, site visitors, and admission enquiries, with office hours from 9:30 am to 5:00 pm. The page also notes that the content is © 2026 and powered by WhiteCode.
